title: Exact db2 cascade norms and an optimal uniform constant
summary: Exact supremum-operator norms for the undecimated periodic db2 cascade. For every level j and every period N at least the support, the norm is c_j^d, where c_j = 1651/1395 - (4/63)4^{-j} + (1/180)16^{-j} - (1/1736)32^{-j}. For every positive period, aliasing included, the norm is at most (1651/1395)^d, and that power is the least constant with this uniform role. The free mass is strictly increasing, converges to 1651/1395, and the gap is at most (4/63)4^{-j}. Dimension zero is exactly 1.
